# Respiratory Risk Report


### Week ending in October 24, 2026


[Marisa Donnelly, PhD](https://substack.com/@marisadonnelly)


Oct 30, 2026


Biobot’s national wastewater network shows that Covid is increasing again, following an unusual pattern this year. In previous years, we’ve seen a summer wave followed by a decline before the winter surge. This year, however, the summer wave has persisted into the fall, with Covid levels now increasing across all U.S. regions. It’s unclear whether we’ll see a decline before winter, when Covid activity typically picks up again.


Meanwhile, flu A continues to rise nationally, with the largest increases in the West. RSV and flu B remain at very low levels, while HMPV continues to decline.


**Bottom line**


Covid is still circulating at elevated levels and is increasing again, while flu A is also on the rise. As we head further into the season, we can expect flu transmission to continue increasing, while it remains unclear what’s ahead for Covid.


If you haven’t yet, now is a good time to get ahead of the season by scheduling your fall vaccines. Which vaccines are recommended depends on your age, health history, and risk factors, so check with your healthcare provider. Most are also available at pharmacies.


---


### **National Outlook**


#### **COVID-19**


Nationally, SARS-CoV-2 is increasing.


#### **Influenza**


Nationally, influenza A is increasing, while influenza B is holding steady at very low levels.


#### **RSV**


Nationally, RSV is increasing.


#### **HMPV**


Nationally, HMPV is decreasing and remains low.


---

**HMPV:** HMPV is holding steady.

**RSV:** RSV is increasing.


**HMPV:** HMPV is decreasing.


#### **The West**


**COVID-19:** SARS-CoV-2 is increasing.


**RSV:** RSV is increasing.
